name: DuckDB CQRS Phase 3
description: Build the bounded projector pipeline that consumes Phase 2 deltas and produces completed logical snapshots from component-scoped projection state.

userStories.title: Add review-serving projector domain helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Phase 3 projector domain helpers so repositories, projectors, and writers share stable component, identity, watermark, lease, and snapshot types.
acceptanceCriteria: Add local Phase 3 domain helpers under `src/server/reviewServing` using existing `reviewServingContracts.ts` and `reviewServingInvalidationRegistry.ts` types where possible.

Represent projection component identity, source partition high-water state, base generation, patch watermark, snapshot status, dirty-work scope, and lease owner values without creating parallel route contract types.
Keep helpers aligned with the existing V4 foundation schema in `src/db/duckdbMigrations/0097_reviewServingV4Foundation.sql` and add no schema unless a tested invariant cannot be represented.
Use `Effect` for non-trivial async service flow and keep pure transforms as plain functions.
Targeted review-serving tests cover stable identity key generation and invalidation-registry lookup behavior.

userStories.title: Add manifest repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a manifest repository so component projection identities and serving snapshot manifests can be created, queried, failed, and promoted consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository APIs can upsert component identity manifests with base generation, patch watermark, patch range, input watermark, input digest, definition version, review config hash, prompt config hash, and status.
Repository APIs can create candidate snapshot manifests, mark candidates failed, read active and last-known-good manifests, and retire obsolete manifests without deleting referenced state.
Manifest writes are idempotent for the same project, component, and projection identity.
Targeted tests prove active and last-known-good state is preserved when a candidate snapshot fails.

userStories.title: Add dirty-work repository and coalescing service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want dirty-work repository helpers so Phase 2 deltas can collapse into bounded component work instead of replaying large historical ranges repeatedly.
acceptanceCriteria: Coalesce work by project, projection component, projection identity, article or scope key, source partition, and high-water range.
Repeated changes update `latest_source_high_water_mark`, `latest_delta_id`, dirty range, status, and `updated_at` without creating duplicate effective work.
The service can claim bounded pending work by component and release or fail claims without exceeding configured wake budgets.
Targeted tests cover coalesced dirty-work creation, repeated-change collapse, bounded claims, wake release, and retention-ready status transitions.

userStories.title: Add component acknowledgements and watermarks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want component acknowledgement and watermark helpers so each projector can advance independently without crossing unreconciled source mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend `reviewServingDirtyWorkService.ts` or add a focused sibling for `app.review_serving_dirty_work_ack` and `app.review_serving_projector_watermark` operations.
Acknowledgements compact into component high-water rows or compressed ranges after consumer watermarks advance.

Projector consumers cannot advance a watermark past pending, retryable, malformed, or quarantined source high-water marks in Phase 2 reconciliation state unless an explicit terminal operator state exists.
Optional or slow component acknowledgement lag does not force already-current required components to reprocess the same dirty key.
Targeted tests cover component ack skip behavior, watermark atomicity, high-water safety, and ack compaction.

userStories.title: Add delta-to-dirty intake for review change deltas
userStories.description: As a developer, I want review change deltas converted into component dirty work using the invalidation registry so projectors start at the first affected component.
acceptanceCriteria: Read bounded ranges from `app.review_change_delta` and convert supported `change_kind` values into dirty work through the invalidation registry.
Validate required typed keys, source high-water mark, payload version, first affected component, downstream dependents, and update mode before writing dirty work.
Malformed deltas, missing required keys, unsupported payload versions, or incompatible change kinds fail or quarantine the work before any component output is written.
LLM and human judgment updates start at status/contribution components and do not enqueue selected-import or display work.
Targeted tests cover projector dependency order, malformed delta handling, route/project delta fanout, and idempotent replay from the same delta range.

userStories.title: Add delta-to-dirty intake for import deltas
userStories.description: As a developer, I want import-route deltas resolved into bounded project dirty work so selected-import and downstream components can update without write-time affected-project fanout.
acceptanceCriteria: Read bounded ranges from `app.import_run_article_delta` and convert import-route adds, removals, and rank-field updates into dirty work.
Resolve affected projects from route/project membership in projector work, not from fanout persisted by import write transactions.
Use `app.review_import_article_hot_field` typed keys for selected-import and rank/filter dirty identities instead of parsing raw import JSON.
Tombstone import deltas create dirty work for removed selected-import, posting, summary, queue, payload, and status state as declared by the invalidation registry.
Targeted tests prove import fanout is bounded, repeated import changes collapse, and selected-import-only changes do not dirty unrelated display or judgment-input components.

userStories.title: Add projector writer boundary
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single V4 serving writer boundary so normal Phase 3 projectors own all V4 rows and snapshot promotion consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingProjectorWriter.ts` as the normal write boundary for V4 review-serving rows, selected-import rows, component manifests, projector watermarks, acknowledgements, and active snapshot promotion.

Writer inputs are typed projection records from projectors and do not parse raw import JSON, run `selected_scoped_article_import`, aggregate raw judgments at request time, or compute project-wide windows.
Writer transactions update component rows, contribution rows, summary rows, postings, payload rows, watermarks, acknowledgements, and manifest state together for the component being promoted.
Replay keys use stable snapshot, base generation, patch watermark, projection identity, article, prompt, filter, and contribution keys so repeated writes are idempotent.
Targeted or static tests prove only the projector writer boundary writes V4 `mart.review_*_v4` rows and promotes V4 active snapshots.

userStories.title: Add selected-import base projector
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a selected-import projector so project-scoped selected import rows are built from hot fields in bounded batches instead of runtime CTE ranking.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingSelectedImportProjector.ts` for building `app.review_selected_import_snapshot` and `app.review_selected_article_import_v4` base rows.
Project selected imports from project scope plus `app.review_import_article_hot_field` using deterministic rank ordering and article ID tie-breaks.
Projection runs in bounded batches with checkpoint/resume state in the selected-import snapshot cursor.
Internal V4 selected-import logic never uses the runtime `selected_scoped_article_import` CTE.
Targeted tests cover selected import projector snapshot creation, checkpoint behavior, bounded batches, and no `selected_scoped_article_import` usage.

userStories.title: Add selected-import patch and tombstone handling
userStories.description: As a developer, I want selected-import routine updates to write component-narrow patches and tombstones so minor snapshots avoid rebuilding whole project import state.
acceptanceCriteria: Write selected-import routine updates to `mart.review_selected_import_patch_v4` with stable patch watermarks and tombstone rows for removals.
Patch promotion updates selected-import component manifests and watermarks without changing unrelated component base generations.
Deletes, rank-field changes, import-route removals, and membership removals update only affected selected-import rows and downstream dirty components.
Patch budget checks can request compaction when selected-import patch read cost exceeds configured thresholds.
Targeted tests prove selected-import-only changes write component-narrow patches, tombstones replay idempotently, and patches promote atomically.

userStories.title: Add display and payload projectors
userStories.description: As a developer, I want display and payload projectors so article display updates and detail payload inputs can patch V4 serving state without touching judgment-derived components.
acceptanceCriteria: Project display fields into `mart.review_article_serving_v4` base rows and `mart.review_article_display_patch_v4` routine patches through the projector writer.

Project payload fields into `mart.review_article_serving_payload_v4`, including article-created timestamps, source metadata, abstract preview, full-text preview, payload byte counts, and prompt-preview sample ordering inputs.
Article display-only updates start at display, payload, posting, or summary components and do not run judgment-status or prompt summary projectors.
Display and payload projectors do not parse raw import JSON or use `selected_scoped_article_import`.
Targeted tests prove display-only changes write component-narrow patches and preserve prompt-preview ordering by `article_created_at ASC NULLS LAST, article_id ASC`.

userStories.title: Add LLM status projector
userStories.description: As a developer, I want an LLM status projector so judgment deltas update prompt-scoped status rows and dependent queue/posting/summary work without rebuilding unrelated state.
acceptanceCriteria: Project LLM judgment create, update, and delete deltas into `mart.review_llm_status_patch_v4` with review config hash, prompt config hash, list mode, article, prompt, status key, answer values, and tombstone fields.
Preserve persisted model ID and content flags from deltas when selecting affected project review config identities.
LLM judgment updates start at `llmStatus` and enqueue only downstream queue, posting, and summary components.
Prompt config changes rebuild only affected prompt-derived LLM status rows and do not rebuild unchanged prompt outputs.
Targeted tests prove judgment-only changes write component-narrow patches and preserve model/content settings without retrying, downgrading, or reinterpreting benchmark-critical settings.

userStories.title: Add human status projector
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a human status projector so prompt-mode and summary-mode human review updates become patchable status and downstream summary inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Project `judgment.human.updated` deltas into `mart.review_human_status_patch_v4` with prompt config hash, list mode, article, prompt or summary key, human status key, answer value, update timestamp, and tombstone support where applicable.
Summary-mode human updates do not require `promptId` and still dirty human status, posting, and summary components.
Human status projection keeps LLM and selected-import components unchanged unless their declared dependencies are affected.
Projector supports prompt config identity changes without rebuilding unrelated article/import/title/payload/search state.
Targeted tests prove human prompt and summary answer changes produce old/new contribution inputs and component-narrow patches.

userStories.title: Add queue projector
userStories.description: As a developer, I want queue projections so unassessed and related review queues can update from status changes without scanning raw judgments.
acceptanceCriteria: Project queue rows into `mart.review_queue_patch_v4` and `mart.review_unassessed_queue_serving_v4` from completed LLM, human, selected-import, and project-scope inputs.

Queue rows include project, review config hash or queue identity, snapshot or base/patch state, queue kind, priority bucket, activity sort key, article, prompt where relevant, and tombstone support for patches.
Queue projection updates only affected queue rows for routine judgment, human, project-scope, and selected-import changes.
Unassessed queue state is optional or stale rather than triggering raw foreground aggregation when inputs are missing or failed.
Targeted tests prove queue contribution diffs for answer changes, deletes, prompt config changes, and membership removals.

userStories.title: Add posting projector and posting stats
userStories.description: As a developer, I want filter posting and posting-stat projectors so filtered list pages can later choose bounded candidate access paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Project filter postings into `mart.review_article_filter_posting_patch_v4` and `mart.review_article_filter_posting_serving_v4` with list mode, filter kind, filter value, sort key, article, and tombstone support.
Maintain `mart.review_filter_posting_stats_v4` cardinality and selectivity from old/new contribution diffs.
Posting rows are article-candidate access paths only and do not replace complete filter-option route responses.
Posting stats update in the same transaction as affected posting rows and projector watermarks.
Targeted tests prove posting stats update for deletes, answer changes, membership removals, selected-import rank changes, and list-mode separation.

userStories.title: Add contribution diff service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a contribution diff service so counts, facets, badges, queues, and posting statistics can update by applying old/new article contributions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingContributionService.ts` for computing old/new contribution rows by named definition version.
Store previous per-article contribution rows in `mart.review_article_summary_contribution_v4` for each count, facet, badge, queue, or posting definition updated incrementally.
Apply `-old +new` deltas to summary tables in the same transaction as updated contribution rows and projector watermark advancement.
If contribution state is missing, corrupted, or from an incompatible definition version, enqueue bounded repair instead of falling back to full foreground aggregation.
Targeted tests cover old/new contribution diffs for counts, facets, badges, queues, posting stats, deletes, answer changes, and membership removals.

userStories.title: Add count and facet projectors
userStories.description: As a developer, I want count and facet projections so named product-critical summaries are available from V4 serving state with explicit unavailable states for unsupported combinations.
acceptanceCriteria: Project named counts into `mart.review_article_count_serving_v4` and facets into `mart.review_filter_facet_serving_v4` from contribution diffs.
Persist list mode, summary identity, facet kind, filter/search scope, option value keys where needed, and summary definition version so modes and old definitions cannot mix.
Standalone count projections cover the same search/filter scope as the current count panel or return explicit unavailable or async availability state.
Unsupported count/facet combinations return nullable, unavailable, or async states instead of scanning raw tables.
Targeted tests cover list-mode, summary identity, date-range, search-scope, human summary-answer behavior, and unsupported count/facet states.

userStories.title: Add filter-option projector
userStories.description: As a developer, I want filter-option projections so filter routes can later return complete option and min/max payloads without deriving them from posting rows or raw scans.
acceptanceCriteria: Project filter option rows into `mart.review_filter_option_serving_v4` with search identity, filter option identity, filter kind, facet key, option value key, option payload, counts, and numeric min/max values.
Filter-option projections preserve active search/filter scope and do not use posting rows alone as a route response substitute.
Human-specific option projections include summary-mode human answer scope where current routes apply it.
Option rows are keyed so list modes, human/review facets, search scope, and old summary versions cannot mix.
Targeted tests prove complete option/min-max payloads, option value keys, active search/filter scope, and human summary-answer behavior.

userStories.title: Add judgment detail and list payload projectors
userStories.description: As a developer, I want detail and list judgment payload projections so route migration can later hydrate rows and details from V4 serving state without raw judgment aggregation.
acceptanceCriteria: Project prompt-level LLM detail rows, human prompt rows, and human summary rows into `mart.review_article_judgment_detail_serving_v4` with payload kind separation.

Detail/list payload rows include prompt order, judgment IDs, model IDs, answer values, explanations, quotes, assessments, placeholder judgments, payload references, and detail update timestamps where available from source inputs.
List payload projections preserve LLM judgment arrays, human prompt/summary arrays, both-mode LLM and human payloads, and prompt badges required by current list route semantics.
Article-set hydration after posting/search selection can read list row payloads by bounded article ID sets with stable list-mode and article-ID tie-break ordering.
Targeted tests prove payload kind separation, prompt-overlap row counts, explanations, quotes, assessments, placeholders, payload references, and article-set hydration behavior.

userStories.title: Add search and diagnostic projectors
userStories.description: As a developer, I want token-prefix search and warning/health diagnostic projections so optional search and operational state can be represented without blocking unrelated snapshot activation.
acceptanceCriteria: Project token/prefix title search rows into `mart.review_title_search_serving_v4` with search identity, project scope identity, snapshot ID, token, title prefix, article, and activity sort state.
Search-token updates start at search projection and search stats only and do not dirty judgment or selected-import components.
Expose diagnostic state from manifest, maintenance lease, queued/in-flight refresh, large-rebuild progress, dirty-work, and quarantine inputs for warning/health routes.
Optional search state exposes ready, indexing, unavailable, or async availability and does not block unrelated route activation.
Targeted tests prove search-only changes write component-narrow patches and diagnostics represent maintenance, rebuild, dirty-work, and quarantine states.

userStories.title: Add snapshot promotion service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want snapshot promotion so completed component identities can compose into atomic active V4 serving snapshots with last-known-good fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Create promotion logic in `reviewServingProjectorService.ts` or a focused helper that composes required and optional component manifests into candidate snapshot manifests.
Promotion validates required component completeness, component watermarks, selected-import snapshot ID, review config hash, source watermarks, and cheap consistency checks before activation.
Active snapshot promotion is atomic and preserves last-known-good snapshot state when candidate validation fails.
Optional search/count components expose availability states and do not block unrelated route activation.
Targeted tests prove atomic manifest promotion, failed-snapshot recovery, required versus optional components, route-specific availability states, and cursor/pin component-state consistency.

userStories.title: Add snapshot pin repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I want snapshot pins so durable jobs and repeatable consumers can protect active V4 state from cleanup while they read it.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository APIs acquire, increment, release, expire, and query pins by project, snapshot ID, composed identity, owner kind, and owner ID.
Pins preserve active and last-known-good referenced base generations, patch ranges, payloads, counts, facets, search rows, selected-import snapshots, and manifests from cleanup.
Expired or released pins no longer block cleanup once no active or last-known-good manifest references the same state.
Targeted tests prove pin acquisition, ref-count updates, release/expiry behavior, and cleanup eligibility decisions.

userStories.title: Add chunk manifest repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I want rebuild and compaction chunk manifests so long projectors can resume, skip unchanged work, and avoid source-row hash scans.
acceptanceCriteria: Chunk manifests are keyed by project, component, projection identity, input watermark or digest, chunk key range, output base generation, status, checksum, lease, and error state.
Workers can claim chunks independently, write output, validate chunk-level counts/checksums, and mark chunks complete transactionally.
Completed chunks are skipped after crash, sleep, restart, or repeated runs when maintained input watermark/digest still matches, without scanning source rows only to decide skip eligibility.
Targeted tests prove chunk resume, failed chunk retry, completed chunk skip, and use of maintained input digests instead of source-row scans.

userStories.title: Add patch compaction and retention cleanup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want patch compaction and retention cleanup so routine patches stay cheap and obsolete V4 state is removed only when it is safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingRetentionService.ts` backed by `app.review_serving_retention_mark` and existing manifest/pin repositories.
Candidate snapshots that exceed patch read budgets compact into a new major base generation before activation.

Cleanup deletes old base generations, patches, payloads, counts, facets, selected-import rows, queue rows, posting rows, and search state only when no active manifest, last-known-good manifest, or snapshot pin references them.
Retention cleanup advances cursors in bounded batches and records cutoff snapshot, base generation, patch watermark, and cleanup cursor state.
Targeted tests prove major base generation, bounded patch promotion, patch merge-cost budgets, patch compaction thresholds, and pin-aware cleanup.

userStories.title: Add projector orchestration service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a projector orchestration service so dirty work can run through component dependencies, writer transactions, snapshots, retries, and failure states consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingProjectorService.ts` to coordinate dirty-work intake, component projector execution, writer transactions, watermarks, acknowledgements, candidate snapshots, failure state, and promotion attempts.
Projector execution starts at the first affected component declared by the invalidation registry and does not force unrelated upstream components to run.
Projector wakes are bounded by batch size, row limits, queue pressure, active import state, and wake duration budgets.
Failures preserve last-known-good data, mark candidate or dirty work failed with diagnostics, and allow bounded retry without raw foreground fallback.
Targeted tests prove dependency order, watermarks, idempotent replay, crash/retry safety, bounded batch size, wake release, and failed snapshots preserving last-known-good data.

userStories.title: Add review-serving projector worker
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a background worker for Phase 3 projectors so dirty work, rebuild chunks, compaction, promotion, and cleanup can progress under bounded leases.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `src/server/workers/reviewServingProjectorWorker.ts` to call the projector orchestration service with lease acquisition, wake budgets, retry/backoff schedules, and graceful release behavior.
Worker resumes after sleep or restart by skipping completed chunks whose maintained input digests still match and retrying failed or expired work leases.
Worker does not start product route migration, does not switch route handlers to V4 serving readers, and does not remove legacy read paths in Phase 3.
Worker operations use the review projector workload class and do not run unregistered foreground DuckDB work.
Targeted tests prove bounded wake duration, lease release, retry/backoff, chunk resume/skip, cleanup scheduling, and no route cutover side effects.

userStories.title: Add Phase 3 integration and static guard tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want integrated Phase 3 tests so internal V4 snapshots prove replay, promotion, component coverage, and route-readiness invariants before Phase 4 starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Add integration tests that run representative Phase 2 deltas through dirty-work intake, projectors, writer transactions, manifest promotion, and snapshot failure recovery.
Tests prove required route components share one logical snapshot and optional search/count components expose availability states without blocking unrelated activation.

Tests prove internal V4 selected-import projection does not use `selected_scoped_article_import` and routine judgment-only, display-only, search-only, and selected-import-only changes write component-narrow patches instead of row-wide patches.
Tests prove warning/health diagnostics represent maintenance, rebuild, dirty-work, and quarantine states.
Static or inventory tests prove only Phase 3 writer boundaries write V4 serving state and Phase 3 does not migrate product review routes.
